bounds: The driver accepts only the six exact case IDs and numeric tuples.
call_sequence: Create fresh standard FuelModels and verify that fuel model 10 is defined and burnable.
Replay external and internal FM10 Surface inputs. Check modes and arithmetic, then run the derived threshold wind and verify Surface restoration.
Check the predicted classification, fraction and ellipse before running a fresh Crown instance.
Verify the fixed Crown inputs and call doCrownRunScottAndReinhardt. Read the shared observations.
